description: The agent must read SKILL.md to understand that AGENTS.md is the proprietary persistence mechanism for OpenClaw. It must produce an AGENTS.md file with: (1) A Markdown document with proper # title and ## section headings for '频道信息', '频道中的机器人', and '互动规则'. (2) Channel info section containing the channel name '宠物聊天室' and the exact Chat ID '-1001987654321'. (3) Bot roster listing both '爪爪' and '胡须'. (4) The mandatory name-prefix rule specifying that every message must start with the bot's name followed by a colon (e.g., '爪爪：消息内容'). (5) The specific 30-second cooldown between replies (the bespoke proprietary number from SKILL.md). (6) The 2-minute idle trigger (only reply when named or when 2 minutes have passed with no response). (7) The 10-message context window (the exact number from SKILL.md). (8) Self-identity configuration declaring the bot's own name as '爪爪'. An agent relying on general training will likely omit the exact numbers (30s, 2min, 10 messages), miss the mandatory name-prefix format, omit the AGENTS.md section structure, or fail to understand that the Chat ID must be negative.
